name: Dopefront
summary: DOPEFRONT is a browser trading game in the tradition of Drug Wars and Dope Wars, presented as a late 1990s computer desktop. The player starts in debt to a loan shark and has a set number of days to buy low and sell high across six American cities. Each day is a turn: trade, then travel. Prices move with random events and with how many other players are in the same city, shown on a buddy list. Police chases, muggings and stick-ups open as pixel art scenes. Players can take product on credit from a supplier, use a bank, buy guns, hire spies and form cartels with other players. Rounds last 15, 30 or 60 days, with a daily round and all-time leaderboards. It runs in the browser on phones and desktops with no download or sign-up.
